steps.title: Scrobble stream
steps.detail: Public scrobbles are pulled nightly and deduplicated.

steps.title: Feature store
steps.detail: Track audio features are extracted with librosa and cached.

steps.title: Two-tower model
steps.detail: A two-tower model is trained with in-batch negatives.

steps.title: ANN index
steps.detail: Item embeddings are indexed in a HNSW graph.

steps.title: API
steps.detail: A FastAPI endpoint returns k-nearest tracks for a seed.
